characters.name: Ash of the Hollow
characters.bio: A keeper of forgotten oaths, following the sound of a bell beneath the city. Fictional design character.

lore.title: The Hollow Gate
lore.text: Beneath the last stair, a door of black stone waits for a name nobody remembers. The bell has not rung for a hundred years. Tonight, it rings twice. Fictional design lore.

rolls.outcome: The runes yield a name. Beyond the arch, something answers. Fictional animation example, not a game event.
